title: The APACHE - SALSA On2 Partnerwork Lesson 13

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor provides clear partnerwork instructions with counts and demonstrates variations. He breaks down movements step by step with a partner.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the Apache turn in Salsa On2.
Breaking down crossover turns and hand pass.

what_works: Clear verbal explanations of partner mechanics
Showing both leader and follower roles

quotes.text: Today we're going to cover one of those common social dancing moves called the Apache.
The first thing that you want to practice and get good at is doing these crossover turns.
The trickiest part about this move is that hammerlock right there.

evidence_segments.observation: Partners demonstrate a salsa partnerwork routine with turns and hand changes on wooden floor.
Instructor demonstrates crossover turns facing camera with partner.

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down the hammerlock by engaging only halfway to let the follower complete the turn.
